uutiset.t: Hormuz Strait Authority Blacklists Tugboats, Raising Pressure on Tanker Traffic
uutiset.s: The Iranian body seeking to control traffic through the Strait of Hormuz added tugboats to its “non-compliance list,” in the latest sign that Tehran is ratcheting up pressure on the ecosystem that’s supporting tanker traffic.

uutiset.t: Zelenskyy Says Congress Should Pressure Russia if Trump Talks Fail
uutiset.s: Volodymyr Zelenskyy says he’ll ask the new Democrat-controlled Congress to pile pressure on Russia if President Trump fails to secure a peace deal by year-end. Alex Morgan has the key takeaways from the Ukrainian president’s exclusive interview with Bloomberg News. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Bank of Canada Fades Core Inflation, Switches Gauges
uutiset.s: The Bank of Canada is changing the metrics it uses to weigh underlying price pressures as part of its new monetary policy framework, Governor Tiff Macklem announced Tuesday.

uutiset.t: Crispier Chicken and Remodels Pit McDonald's Against Franchisees
uutiset.s: Franchise owners are pushing back on the CEO's multibillion-dollar plan to tear down walls, add big video screens and make hand-breaded chicken. Bloomberg's Daniela Sirtori reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Bank of Canada Warns of Oil Passthrough, Sticky Inflation
uutiset.s: The head of the Bank of Canada warned that higher oil costs will be passed on to consumers as the economy holds up better than officials expected.

uutiset.t: Iraq Rejects OPEC+ Assessment of Its Oil Production Capacity
uutiset.s: Iraq has rejected an assessment of its oil production capacity commissioned by OPEC+, according to people familiar with the matter, setting up a potential clash at this weekend’s key meeting on production targets.

uutiset.t: What Really Matters for the AI Trade Now? Live Q&A
uutiset.s: From Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia to swings in the AI trade, Bloomberg journalists answer your questions in a Live Q&A today at 1 p.m. EST.

uutiset.t: European Gas Surges as Cold Snap Threatens Tight Winter Supplies
uutiset.s: European natural gas prices jumped as a sharply colder weather outlook intensified concerns over Europe’s winter supplies, already under pressure from export disruptions linked to the US-Iran war. Joe Wertz reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Stocks Fall as Jensen Huang Fueled Stock Rally Quickly Fades
uutiset.s: Jonathan Ferro, Lisa Abramowicz and Annmarie Hordern speak daily with leaders and decision makers from Wall Street to Washington and beyond. No other program better positions investors and executives for the trading day than "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Nvidia (NVDA) Surging on Huang’s Reinstatement Brings Back Leveraged ETF Debate
uutiset.s: Nvidia’s stock-price surge created big winners and losers among leveraged ETF investors

uutiset.t: Kalshi Users Under 21 Lost $8.9 Million in NYC, Probe Finds
uutiset.s: Over 50,000 people between the ages of 18 and 21 are using Kalshi in New York City, and they are losing money at a disproportionate rate, according to internal data that Kalshi released to the New York City Council.

uutiset.t: Turkey Frees Ex-Minister Jailed in Fund Crisis After 18 Days
uutiset.s: Turkey released former minister Fatma Betul Sayan Kaya from jail just 18 days after she was arrested in an investment-fund investigation that’s shaken the country’s markets.

uutiset.t: Anthropic Shares Plunge Below IPO Price in Fourth Trading Day
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC shares sank as much as nearly 9% below their $83 initial public offering price, wiping out gains for investors who piled into the artificial intelligence lab’s record-setting debut last week.

uutiset.t: Colleges Rejecting Fossil Fuel Divestment Enjoy a Rich Payoff
uutiset.s: For years, campus and environmental activists concerned about climate change have pressured colleges to divest from fossil fuel companies. But those that hung tight are now glad they did. Bloomberg’s Janet Lorin explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Nasdaq 100 Tumbles as Nvidia Euphoria Fades, New Tariffs Floated
uutiset.s: The Nasdaq 100 Index plunged on Tuesday, led by another steep decline in chipmakers as a relief rally in technology stocks gave way to renewed worries about the durability of the AI trade. Plans for new US tariffs also weighed on stocks, reigniting trade concerns.
